help.title: About Rental payments
help.overview: A Rental payment is one scheduled month on a lease. Remaining is derived (amount + late fee − paid). Status moves pending → paid | partially paid | overdue, or waived. You collect here; you do not redefine the lease rent here. Prefer letting the lease generate the schedule rather than creating months by hand.

sections.title: What a row holds
items: Parent lease, unit, due date, amount, paid amount, remaining, currency.
Status: pending, paid, partially paid, overdue, waived.
Late fee amount (stamped when the month becomes overdue).
Payment receipts (each slice of a collection with date and notes).

sections.title: Actions
items: Mark paid — record an amount against this month only (parent lease must be active). Full pay sets paid; partial sets partially paid. Cannot overpay remaining. Cannot collect on already paid or waived rows.
Waive — forgive remaining on an open row. Cannot waive what is already paid.
Recording a payment on the lease (FIFO) may fill this row as part of a larger amount — same remaining math.

sections.title: On this page
items: Filter overdue vs pending vs paid.
Open a row to collect or waive.
Create rarely by hand — leases generate the schedule; resync on the lease if months are wrong.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Overdue considers grace period from the lease; a daily job flips the status and can apply late fee once.
Dashboard “rent collected / outstanding / overdue” sums these rows.
Terminating or expiring a lease waives still-open rows.
